title: Pastoralists in the Modern World
subtitle: Nomadic Life, Colonial Rules, and Survival
subject: Social Science (History)
author: Shine Academy EduOS
learning_outcomes: Understand the life of pastoral nomads in India and Africa.
Analyze the impact of colonial policies on pastoral communities.
Examine how pastoralists adapted to modern changes.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the historical context of pastoralism and how colonialism altered their sustainable ways of life.
common_misconceptions: Pastoralists aimlessly wander (they actually have calculated seasonal migrations).
Nomadism is an outdated lifestyle with no relevance today.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If a student struggles, ask: 'Why would a herder need to move their animals during different seasons? What happens if they stay in one place all year?'
